nodes.label: Model-Agnostic Organizational Intelligence Layer
nodes.rationale: AI Studio is positioned as 'Git for AI-native work' where context is the primary object rather than chat sessions. The goal is to accumulate knowledge, decisions, reasoning, and artifacts so teams never re-explain context to AI.

nodes.label: Context as Primary Object (not chat)
nodes.rationale: Design principle: context accumulates across sessions and branches rather than being ephemeral per-chat. Enables knowledge persistence and cross-branch RAG.

nodes.label: CVA Variant System for Button
nodes.rationale: class-variance-authority (CVA) is used to define button variants (default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link) and sizes (default, sm, lg, icon) in a type-safe, composable way.

nodes.label: Electron Context Isolation (security boundary)
nodes.rationale: contextIsolation: true, nodeIntegration: false, sandbox: false in webPreferences. The preload script bridges the gap safely via contextBridge.

nodes.label: BYOK Multi-Provider Routing (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, CodexOAuth)
nodes.norm_label: byok multi-provider routing (anthropic, openai, google, codexoauth)

nodes.label: Git-like Branch Hierarchy for Conversations
nodes.rationale: Org → Project → Chat → Branch hierarchy. Branches can be forked from any point (forkAtIndex) enabling non-linear conversation exploration analogous to git branching.

nodes.label: LSP Client (definition, references, hover, diagnostics, rename)

nodes.label: Content Security Policy (self-only, no external fetch)
nodes.rationale: CSP restricts scripts and styles to 'self' with 'unsafe-inline' for styles only. Prevents XSS and unwanted external script loading in the Electron renderer context.
